ns2:section.sectionText: Full section title: Digital Competencies for the Performing Artist Completion of this course will result in the acquisition of basic capabilities in the recording, editing, and distribution of digital performances. The majority of the course will be asynchronous with synchronous participation in three small group sessions in weeks 6, 10, and 14/15 where students will share their work online and can receive help in troubleshooting the topics covered in the class. The date and time will be set to accommodate student schedules and preferences. Taught by Michael Tilley (tilley@illinois.edu) and Lamont Holden (holden@illinois.edu).
